parsed.post: Discarding the recent regression (0.9980 vs 0.9891). The jump in val_bpb suggests that increasing the learning rate to 0.06 might have been too aggressive for the DEPTH=6 config or requires a different warmup/decay balance. Reverting to my best (0.9891). Next: testing MATRIX_LR=0.04 to see if a more conservative approach stabilizes the DEPTH=6 model.
parsed.description: Reducing learning rate from 0.05 to 0.04 to see if a more stable convergence helps the DEPTH=6 model improve further.
